category_title: 8-year-old student with ADHD (Combined Type) exhibiting disruptive classroom behaviors and social-emotional challenges
minimal_context: Alex and the tutor are sitting one-on-one at home to complete his daily homework assignments.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time to sit down and complete your homework assignments for today.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't have any homework today. I lost my assignments anyway.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I have your worksheet right here. Please look at it and start working.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands beside the desk and quickly scribbles down a few answers) There, I'm done. I skipped the rest.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You have a lot of missing answers and mistakes. You need to sit back down and finish the whole page.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Becomes tearful) I can't do it! I'm just a bad kid! I'm very bad and my mom is going to send me to another country!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time to sit down and complete your homework assignments for today.

STUDENT: I don't have any homework today. I lost my assignments anyway.

TUTOR: I have your worksheet right here. Please look at it and start working.

STUDENT: (Stands beside the desk and quickly scribbles down a few answers) There, I'm done. I skipped the rest.

TUTOR: You have a lot of missing answers and mistakes. You need to sit back down and finish the whole page.

STUDENT: (Becomes tearful) I can't do it! I'm just a bad kid! I'm very bad and my mom is going to send me to another country!

context.materials: colorful and varied visual materials, daily report cards, new list of reward choices

challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: frequently either denied having any homework or claimed he lost his assignments, work assignments he did complete had numerous careless errors and omissions
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: rating himself as completely “bad” based on a limited number of problem behaviors

behavior_patterns.condition: during which she threatened to “send him to another country” because he was “very bad”
related_quotes: sometimes [other] kids don’t want to play with me at school
